name: Place on surface or fixture
definition: Pick up one or more objects and place them on or move them to a specified non-container target, such as a table, chair, shelf, toilet, holder, or towel rack.

name: Place inside container
definition: Pick up one or more objects and place them inside a specified or implied container or appliance, such as a drawer, cabinet, safe, bin, trash can, fridge, or microwave, opening and closing it as needed.

name: Clean or dry then place
definition: Clean, wash, or dry one or more objects and then put them at the specified destination.

name: Heat in microwave then place
definition: Heat one or more objects in the microwave and place them at the specified final location when one is given.

name: Cool in fridge then place
definition: Cool one or more objects in the fridge and place them at the specified final location when one is given.

name: Toggle device
definition: Turn a specified device on or off, such as a lamp, optionally while moving another object.
